title: The OTR Symposium 2026: Shaping the Open Transition takes place in one week!
content:
The first Open Technology Research (OTR) Symposium – the OTR Symposium 2026: Shaping the Transition – kicks off in one week, on 26 and 27 October 2026 at the University of Barcelona. The final agenda is now confirmed: three headline sessions, 18 research presentations across five thematic tracks and an open source hardware block, a panel on Barcelona’s own open transition, and the presentation of the Basil Cousins Award.

The OTR Symposium 2026 is convened by the founding members of Open Technology Research: OpenForum Europe, the Open Source Initiative, the Open Knowledge Foundation, and the Digital Infrastructure Insights Fund. It builds on OFE’s OpenForum Academy Symposium, which ran from 2021 to 2025, and takes place as part of Barcelona Open Tech Week. The Symposium is one of several events in Barcelona Open Tech Week, alongside Mozilla Festival, Decidim Fest, the 4D Conference, the Open Source Policy Summit and the Global Assembly for Open Source.
